name: Amagase Rinko
source: A new teacher in her first year of working life. Clumsy and foolish. When she makes a mistake, she just gets flustered and is always apologizing repeatedly. She has a baby face and is short, so he is often mistaken for someone else, which bothers him a lot. She goes home as soon as he finishes work.
